statement: All custom analysis code is archived at https://doi.org/10.0000/synthetic-code.1 (C1, v1.0.0, Apache-2.0) with a pinned environment specification. The comparison method is the public implementation at https://doi.org/10.0000/synthetic-baseline.4 (C2, v2.3.1). The vendor acquisition driver (C3) is controlled by Synthetic Instruments Ltd and released only to licensed instrument owners; the converted open-format files and all downstream analysis are included in C1.
